1	/**
2	 * POST /api/billing/connect/onboard
3	 *
4	 * Creates a Stripe Connect Express account for the studio or an artist, records it
5	 * via the stripe_connected_account_create RPC, and returns a Stripe-hosted KYC URL.
6	 *
7	 * Authorization: authenticated session, studio owner or admin role.
8	 * Rate limit: authedRatelimit (60 req/min).
9	 *
10	 * Body: { type: 'studio' | 'artist'; artist_id?: string }
11	 * Response 200: { url: string; expires_at: number; account_id: string }
12	 * Response 409: { error: 'already_onboarded' } — account already active
13	 *
14	 * NOTE: stripe_connected_accounts table is created by Track C migration. Until that
15	 * migration lands, DB calls against that table will fail at runtime (not compile time)
16	 * because we use `unknown` casts to work around the absent Supabase-generated types.
17	 */
18	import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
19	import { z } from 'zod'
20	import { createClient, getAuthenticatedUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
21	import { authedRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
22	import { getClientIp } from '@/lib/rate-limit/get-client-ip'
23	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
24	import { logAuditAction } from '@/lib/audit'
25	import { createConnectAccount, createAccountLink } from '@/lib/stripe/connect'
26	import type { ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus, ConnectedAccountType, Currency } from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
27	
28	export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
29	
30	const BodySchema = z.object({
31	  type: z.enum(['studio', 'artist']),
32	  /** Required when type='artist'. UUID of the artist. */
33	  artist_id: z.string().uuid().optional(),
34	})
35	
36	/** Rows returned from stripe_connected_accounts (typed here until Track C migration generates types). */
37	interface ConnectedAccountLookupRow {
38	  account_id: string
39	  onboarding_status: ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus
40	}
41	
42	/** Artist row shape we need for auth check. */
43	interface ArtistLookupRow {
44	  id: string
45	  profile_id: string | null
46	  studio_id: string
47	}
48	
49	/** Profile row. */
50	interface ProfileLookupRow {
51	  email: string | null
52	}
53	
54	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
55	// POST handler
56	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	
58	export async function POST(req: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
59	  // Step 1: Rate limit by IP
60	  const ip = getClientIp(req)
61	  const rl = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
62	  if (!rl.success) {
63	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'rate limit exceeded' }, { status: 429 })
64	  }
65	
66	  // Step 2: Auth — require authenticated session
67	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
68	  if (!auth) {
69	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
70	  }
71	
72	  // Step 3: Studio role check — owner or admin only
73	  if (auth.role !== 'owner' && auth.role !== 'admin') {
74	    return NextResponse.json(
75	      { error: 'owner or admin role required to manage Connect onboarding' },
76	      { status: 403 },
77	    )
78	  }
79	
80	  // Step 4: Parse and validate body
81	  const parsed = BodySchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})))
82	  if (!parsed.success) {
83	    return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
84	  }
85	
86	  const { type, artist_id: artistId } = parsed.data
87	
88	  // artist_id is required when type='artist'
89	  if (type === 'artist' && !artistId) {
90	    return NextResponse.json(
91	      { error: 'artist_id is required when type is artist' },
92	      { status: 400 },
93	    )
94	  }
95	
96	  const supabase = await createClient()
97	  const studioId = auth.studioId
98	  const appUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? ''
99	
100	  // Step 5: If type='artist', verify artistId belongs to this studio.
101	  //         Caller must be studio owner/admin OR the artist themselves.
102	  if (type === 'artist' && artistId) {
103	    const { data: artistRaw, error: artistErr } = await supabase
104	      .from('artists')
105	      .select('id, profile_id, studio_id')
106	      .eq('id', artistId)
107	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
108	      .maybeSingle()
109	
110	    if (artistErr) {
111	      logger.error({ err: artistErr, artistId, studioId }, 'connect onboard: artist lookup failed')
112	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'internal error' }, { status: 500 })
113	    }
114	
115	    if (!artistRaw) {
116	      return NextResponse.json(
117	        { error: 'artist not found in this studio' },
118	        { status: 404 },
119	      )
120	    }
121	
122	    const artist = artistRaw as unknown as ArtistLookupRow
123	
124	    // Caller must be studio owner/admin (already checked above) OR the artist themselves.
125	    // For non-owner callers: their profile_id must match the artist's profile_id.
126	    const isArtistSelf = artist.profile_id === auth.user.id
127	    const isOwnerOrAdmin = auth.role === 'owner' || auth.role === 'admin'
128	    if (!isOwnerOrAdmin && !isArtistSelf) {
129	      return NextResponse.json(
130	        { error: 'forbidden: you can only initiate onboarding for yourself or as studio owner/admin' },
131	        { status: 403 },
132	      )
133	    }
134	  }
135	
136	  // Step 6: Check if a connected account already exists for this (studio, type, artist_id).
137	  //
138	  // stripe_connected_accounts is not yet in the Supabase-generated types (Track C migration pending).
139	  // We cast through `unknown` to avoid compile errors while keeping runtime correctness.
140	  let existingAccountId: string | null = null
141	  let existingOnboardingStatus: ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus | null = null
142	
143	  try {
144	    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- table absent from types until Track C migration
145	    const query = (supabase as unknown as { from: (t: string) => any })
146	      .from('stripe_connected_accounts')
147	      .select('account_id, onboarding_status')
148	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
149	      .eq('type', type)
150	
151	    if (type === 'artist' && artistId) {
152	      query.eq('artist_id', artistId)
153	    } else {
154	      query.is('artist_id', null)
155	    }
156	
157	    const { data: existing, error: accountErr } = await query.maybeSingle() as {
158	      data: ConnectedAccountLookupRow | null
159	      error: { message: string } | null
160	    }
161	
162	    if (accountErr) {
163	      logger.error({ err: accountErr, studioId, type }, 'connect onboard: account lookup failed')
164	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'internal error' }, { status: 500 })
165	    }
166	
167	    if (existing) {
168	      existingAccountId = existing.account_id
169	      existingOnboardingStatus = existing.onboarding_status
170	
171	      // Already fully onboarded — nothing to do
172	      if (existingOnboardingStatus === 'active') {
173	        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'already_onboarded' }, { status: 409 })
174	      }
175	
176	      // Has a connected account in non-active state — reuse it, skip creation
177	      logger.info(
178	        { accountId: existingAccountId, status: existingOnboardingStatus },
179	        'connect onboard: reusing existing non-active account',
180	      )
181	    }
182	  } catch (lookupErr) {
183	    // If the table doesn't exist yet (pre-migration), treat as no account found and proceed
184	    logger.warn(
185	      { err: lookupErr, studioId, type },
186	      'connect onboard: stripe_connected_accounts table not found (migration pending) — creating new account',
187	    )
188	  }
189	
190	  // Step 7: Create a new connected account if none exists
191	  let accountId: string
192	
193	  if (!existingAccountId) {
194	    // Fetch studio currency for defaultCurrency
195	    const { data: studioRaw, error: studioErr } = await supabase
196	      .from('studios')
197	      .select('currency')
198	      .eq('id', studioId)
199	      .single()
200	
201	    if (studioErr || !studioRaw) {
202	      logger.error({ err: studioErr, studioId }, 'connect onboard: studio lookup failed')
203	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'internal error' }, { status: 500 })
204	    }
205	
206	    // Use the authenticated user's email from their auth session
207	    const email = auth.user.email ?? ''
208	    if (!email) {
209	      logger.error({ studioId }, 'connect onboard: cannot determine email for Stripe KYC')
210	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'user email not available' }, { status: 500 })
211	    }
212	
213	    // For artist type, try to get the artist's own profile email
214	    let resolvedEmail = email
215	    if (type === 'artist' && artistId) {
216	      const { data: profileRaw } = await supabase
217	        .from('profiles')
218	        .select('email')
219	        .eq('id', auth.user.id)
220	        .maybeSingle()
221	      const profile = profileRaw as unknown as ProfileLookupRow | null
222	      if (profile?.email) {
223	        resolvedEmail = profile.email
224	      }
225	    }
226	
227	    // currency: validate against supported Currency union; default to 'usd'
228	    const rawCurrency = (studioRaw.currency ?? 'usd').toLowerCase()
229	    const supportedCurrencies: Currency[] = ['usd', 'gbp', 'eur', 'aud', 'cad']
230	    const defaultCurrency: Currency = supportedCurrencies.includes(rawCurrency as Currency)
231	      ? (rawCurrency as Currency)
232	      : 'usd'
233	
234	    // country: default 'US' (studio country column pending future migration)
235	    const country = 'US'
236	
237	    try {
238	      const result = await createConnectAccount(supabase, {
239	        studioId,
240	        type: type as ConnectedAccountType,
241	        artistId,
242	        country,
243	        defaultCurrency,
244	        email: resolvedEmail,
245	      })
246	      accountId = result.accountId
247	    } catch (err) {
248	      logger.error({ err, studioId, type }, 'connect onboard: account creation failed')
249	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'failed to create connected account' }, { status: 500 })
250	    }
251	  } else {
252	    accountId = existingAccountId
253	  }
254	
255	  // Step 8: Generate Stripe-hosted account link for KYC
256	  const typeParam = type
257	  const artistParam = artistId ?? ''
258	  const returnUrl = `${appUrl}/settings/payments?onboarding=complete&type=${typeParam}`
259	  const refreshUrl = `${appUrl}/api/billing/connect/refresh-link?type=${typeParam}&artist_id=${artistParam}`
260	
261	  let linkUrl: string
262	  let expiresAt: number
263	
264	  try {
265	    const link = await createAccountLink({ accountId, returnUrl, refreshUrl })
266	    linkUrl = link.url
267	    expiresAt = link.expiresAt
268	  } catch (err) {
269	    logger.error({ err, accountId }, 'connect onboard: account link creation failed')
270	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'failed to create onboarding link' }, { status: 500 })
271	  }
272	
273	  // Step 9: Audit log — never throws (failures logged internally)
274	  await logAuditAction(
275	    auth.user.authId,
276	    'connect_onboarding_started',
277	    { type: 'stripe_connected_account', id: accountId },
278	    {
279	      account_type: type,
280	      artist_id: artistId ?? null,
281	      was_existing_account: !!existingAccountId,
282	    },
283	    studioId,
284	  )
285	
286	  return NextResponse.json({ url: linkUrl, expires_at: expiresAt, account_id: accountId })
287	}

3	import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
4	import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
5	import { toast } from 'sonner'
6	
7	/**
8	 * Client component that reads Stripe's return params after onboarding redirect.
9	 *
10	 * When Stripe sends the user back to /settings/payments?onboarding=complete&type=studio,
11	 * this fires a toast and triggers a server-side refresh to pick up the updated DB state.
12	 *
13	 * Animation: 150ms ease-out fade-up via Tailwind animate-in (CSS @starting-style approach).
14	 * We don't confetti on completion — editorial restraint is the brand.
15	 */
16	export function ConnectReturnHandler() {
17	  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
18	  const router = useRouter()
19	  const handledRef = useRef(false)
20	
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    if (handledRef.current) return
23	
24	    const onboarding = searchParams.get('onboarding')
25	    const type = searchParams.get('type')
26	
27	    if (onboarding === 'complete' && type === 'studio') {
28	      handledRef.current = true
29	
30	      toast('Verification submitted.', {
31	        description: 'Stripe will email you when your account is ready.',
32	        duration: 6000,
33	      })
34	
35	      // Refresh the Server Component tree to re-fetch DB state
36	      router.refresh()
37	
38	      // Clean up URL params without adding a history entry
39	      const url = new URL(window.location.href)
40	      url.searchParams.delete('onboarding')
41	      url.searchParams.delete('type')
42	      window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.pathname + url.search)
43	    }
44	  }, [searchParams, router])
45	
46	  return null
47	}
